title: Decarbonising price formation: unit-level evidence on battery storage and the imbalance price in the GB Balancing Mechanism
abstract: arXiv:2608.29818v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Renewables now dominate Great Britain's generation mix but rarely occupy the marginal price-setting position, which raises the question of which flexible technologies translate a renewable-rich system into real-time price formation. This study reconstructs the price-ranked edge of the eligible bid or offer stack in the GB Balancing Mechanism across 50,684 half-hourly Settlement Periods from 2023 to 2025 and attributes it to individual Balancing Mechanism Units, separating long-system bid-active from short-system offer-active conditions and retaining co-marginal ties. Batteries rose from 0.8% to 36.2% of bid-active and from 3.2% to 26.9% of offer-active marginality, displacing combined-cycle gas on the bid side and pumped storage on the offer side. Capacity-normalised marginal capture rose on both sides, and unit-quarter fixed effects show that an additional 100 MW of Balancing Mechanism active capacity was associated with a 0.55 and 0.

translated_title: 脱碳的价格形成：关于电池储能与英国平衡机制不平衡价格的单元级证据
translated_abstract: 可再生能源如今主导着英国的发电结构，但很少占据边际定价的位置，这引出了一个问题：哪些灵活性技术将可再生能源丰富的系统转化为实时价格形成。本研究重建了2023年至2025年间50,684个半小时结算期内英国平衡机制中符合条件的投标或报价堆栈的价格排序边缘，并将其归因于各个平衡机制单元，区分了长系统下投标活跃与短系统下报价活跃的情形，并保留了共同边际的并列情况。电池在投标活跃边际性中的占比从0.8%升至36.2%，在报价活跃边际性中的占比从3.2%升至26.9%，在投标侧取代了联合循环燃气机组，在报价侧取代了抽水蓄能。容量归一化的边际捕获率在两侧均有所上升，单元-季度固定效应显示，平衡机制活跃容量每增加100兆瓦，与0.55和0……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究利用2023–2025年英国平衡机制逾5万个半小时结算期的单元级数据，首次量化证明电池储能正迅速取代联合循环燃气机组和抽水蓄能，成为实时不平衡价格形成的主导边际技术，推动英国电力市场定价体系的脱碳化。
en_tdlr: Using over 50,000 half-hourly settlement periods from 2023–2025, this study provides unit-level evidence that battery storage has rapidly displaced combined-cycle gas and pumped storage as the dominant marginal price-setting technology in Great Britain's Balancing Mechanism, decarbonising real-time price formation.
